test_list_credential_helpers: test the list_credential_helpers function to retrieve configured git credential helpers for a repository
test_set_git_credential: test the set_git_credential function to store a git token and username in the credential store
test_unset_git_credential: test the unset_git_credential function to remove stored git credentials for a username
test_parse_credential_output: test the _parse_credential_output function to parse git credential helper config lines into a sorted list
test_git_credentials_workflow: test the full git credential workflow of setting, verifying, and unsetting credentials in a local repo
